يتقارضوا (form VI)
# يَتَقَارَضُوا (yataqāraḍū) /ja.ta.qaː.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
# يُتَقَارَضُوا (yutaqāraḍū) /ju.ta.qaː.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَارَضَ (taqāraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
